round3_summaries: Nuclear power is viewed as an essential 24/7 energy source that ensures grid stability and supports the economy through high-paying jobs, particularly when compared to the intermittency of renewable sources.

The risks associated with long-term radioactive waste and potential catastrophic accidents are seen as too significant to justify nuclear adoption, especially as renewable energy and storage technologies become more cost-effective.

Any expansion of nuclear energy is considered acceptable only if it is subject to rigorous oversight and the highest safety standards to ensure that economic and reliability benefits do not compromise long-term environmental health.
